vision.name: Supreme Kai
vision.text:
[Instant] POWER: Use when entering combat. Look at the top 5 cards of your opponent's Life Deck and put them back in any order.
POWER: [Attack] Energy attack. You may shuffle any number of cards from your hand into your Life Deck to draw the same number of cards.
DAMAGE: 5 life card.
